verses.text: Ix smolb'ankot masanil heb' chonhab' israel winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ix yak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik Jehová t'ayin, to ol he k'anab'ajej.
Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo yukil k'uhal, yikxo Jehová yaji. He masanil t'a jun k'u chi' tzeyik' heyip, tzeyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ha mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi' yowalil schami.
Wach'chom he k'ak', max yal-laj heyak'anoch t'a jun k'uhal chi' yalnhej b'aj kajan hex, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel icha tik: Ha juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová:
Tzeyak' junok ofrenda t'ay. Ha mach tz'el wal t'a sk'o'ol yak'ani, syal yik'ankot k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce,
anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al, anh lino te wach' yet' xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il.
Syalpax heyik'ankot stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak, nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i yet' pax te' acacia.
Tzeyik'paxkot yaceite'al sat te' olivo tz'em t'a yol candil, perfume sb'at t'a skal aceite tz'ak'ji'och t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, sb'atpax t'a skal incienso suk'uk'i sjab'.
Tzeyik'paxkot k'e'en kornalina yet' juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en yelxo wal wach' yilji tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sacerdote, tz'ochpax yelwanub' jun smakul snhi' sk'o'ol winh.
Masanil heb' winh winak jelan sb'o'an tastak wach' yilji, kotokab' heb' winh, yik sb'o'an tas heb' winh ix schek Jehová sb'o'i:
Haton mantiado skajnub' Jehová yet' pax juntzanh tz'och t'a yib'anh yet' pax sganchoal, smarco'al, sregla'il, yoyal yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Sb'opax te' skaxa'il trato, sregla'il tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, junok cortina tz'och smakulok,
te' mexa yet' regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok yet' pax syamk'ab'il, ixim pan tz'ak'ji'och t'a yichanh Jehová.
Sb'opax sb'akhnub'al candil yet' masanil syamk'ab'il yet' pax uke' candil yet' aceite tz'em t'a yol juntzanh candil chi'.
Sb'ojipax altar yik incienso, regla tz'och sb'akhlab'ilok, aceite sk'anchaji yik tz'och t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, incienso suk'uk'i sjab', k'apak cortina yik smakul sti' skajnub' Jehová.
Sb'opax junok altar b'aj stz'a silab', smalla'il jun altar chi' nab'a bronce yet' sregla'il yet' masanil syamk'ab'il. Sb'o jun palangana yet' sb'akhnub'al.
Sb'opax k'apak cortina tzek' hoyan t'a spatik yamak'il skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'apak cortina tz'och smakulok sti' amak' chi'.
Sb'o yestaca'il yet' sch'anhal syamanem t'a spatiktak jun skajnub' Jehová chi' yet' t'a yamak'il.

Sb'opax k'apak pichul jalb'il syak'och heb' sacerdote t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Haton pichul syak'och winhaj sacerdote Aarón to yiknhej yopisio winh yaji yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, haton syak'och heb' ha tz'och heb' t'a yopisio, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi yalan masanil juntzanh chi' winhaj Moisés chi', ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a yoltak smantiado.
Ha heb' ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix laj yak' silab' heb' yik sb'oji skajnub' Jehová, haton b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' masanil tas tz'och yopisio yet' k'apak pichul yik yopisio heb' sacerdote.

Ix laj jawi heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' silab' t'a Jehová, hato syala' jantak ix el t'a sk'o'ol heb' yak'ani, ix ul yak'an heb' t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Ix yik'ankot k'e'en yelwanub' pichul heb', k'e'en kolk'ab', k'e'en tonh, k'e'en uchikin yet' juntzanhokxo nab'a oro. Ix yak'an heb' t'a Jehová.

Masanil heb' ay ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak t'ay, ch'al yaxmakinak, chak ch'al, lino te wach', xil nok' chiwa b'ayb'il, stz'umal nok' ch'ak kalnel uk'nak yet' chakchak yet' pax nok' tz'u'um te lab'ab'i, ix laj yik'kot heb' t'a Jehová.
Ay pax mach ix el t'a sk'o'ol yik'ankot k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce yofrenda'ok t'a Jehová. Ha heb' ay te' acacia t'ay, ix yik'paxkot te' heb', yik sk'anchaj te' t'a skajnub' Dios.
Haxo heb' ix ix syal sb'o'an anh ch'al, ix yik'kot ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak heb' ix, ch'al yaxmakinak, chak ch'al yet' lino te wach'.
Ay heb' ix ix jelan ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix och ijan heb' ix sb'o'an xil nok' chiwa t'a ch'alil.

Haxo heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ix yik'kot k'e'en kornalina heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yik tz'och yelwanub'ok schaleka winh sat sacerdote yet' yochpax yelwanub'ok jun smakul snhi' sk'o'ol winh.
Ix yik'paxkot perfume heb', aceite sk'anchaj t'a candil, aceite sk'anchaj t'a junok tz'ochkan yikok Jehová yet' incienso suk'uk'i sjab'.
Masanil heb' chonhab' israel, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix to ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol, ix yak' skolwal heb' t'a masanil jun munlajel ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a masanil heb' yetchonhab': Ha Jehová toxo ix sik'anel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur, t'a yinhtilal Judá.
Ix yak'anoch Yespíritu Dios chi' t'a winh yik syak'an sjelanil spensar winh yet' yojtakanel winh yik syalpax snachajel yuj winh
sb'o'an yechel tas sb'o'o, icha t'a k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce.
Ix ak'jipax sjelanil winh yik sb'o'anpax k'e'en k'e'en yelxo wal wach', yik sb'o'anpaxem yechel te te' yelxo wal wach' tz'aji yet' yoch yelwanub' te'.
Ix yak'an sjelanil Jehová t'a winh yet' t'a winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, t'a yinhtilal Dan, yik sk'ayb'an juntzanhxo heb' skolwaj yet' heb'.

Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' yuj Jehová, yik sb'o'an masanil tastak heb' to yelxo wal wach' yilji: Yik sb'o'an yechel, yik sb'o'anoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' lino ch'al te wach'. Ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' sb'o'an junok tas wach' yet' sch'oxan yechel junokxo yalnhej tas munlajelal.
